notes: The 'two separate groups' check is not a real problem for this manual, so I kept both groups. Set 7731 includes two separate models: the mailbox (b1-b6, page 3, steps 1-4) and the mail van (b7-b62, pages 4-15, steps 1-17). No step fastens the mailbox to the van. Page 15 only shows the mailbox standing next to the van, so a joined edge would be invented.
The minifigure (cap, head, torso, legs) on pages 2 and 15 is not in the official parts list, so it is not modelled.
Step 2 of the mailbox shows the curved 2x2 brick on the box; I assumed it sits on the box's top studs.
The letters (tiles) are slid into the box slot and rest there, so they get contact edges rather than joined edges.
The van's brick-by-brick stacking in steps 9-16 is hard to read in the small pictures, so I guessed which plates and bricks join which. Ports are left null throughout.
The two door-rail plates at the rear (b27, b28) and the second 1x4 red plate (b29) were placed from the pictures and parts counts, and their exact positions are uncertain.
Stickers are modelled as one sheet (b35) stuck to the two side panels.
The 3022 plates b11 and b12 are assumed to sit under the base to hold the wheel holders, from the underside view in steps 2-3.
